answer: A newcomer must lock 350 spendable POA in a 42-hour canyon delay vault and publish a hash-committed hardware quote. When the vault matures, a verifiable-random beacon discloses one raven from a rotating 96-member notary ring; that notary and one already-established neighbor must confirm the quote is unique across the last ten epochs. Only then does a single-use admission ticket vest. If the same hardware reappears, the vault burns at the next tide settlement, so cloned fleets cannot cheaply multiply votes.
